scope: Direct incumbent versus bundled additive diagnostics and refined proof optimization. A live difference cannot be attributed solely to proof traversal. Batching is fixed on for both arms; this series does not select a batching default.
series_gates: All four arms pass existing correctness, completion, normal quantum, ingress >=95%, canonical backpressure <=1%, lane, cleanup and strict reuse gates.
All four arms offer more logical TPS than canonical TPS for capacity comparison.
Both matched pairs pass fixed environment, resource limits, harness and exact declared source-image checks.
A1/A2 and B1/B2 preserve identical immutable service image IDs.
B1/B2 preserve exact validator container ID and StartedAt.
Both paired canonical TPS gains must be positive for a measured higher-TPS candidate; both must be >=2% to claim repeatable >=2%.
All raw runs are retained; any failed gate prevents promotion. Auxiliary source-provenance gap remains disclosed.
preparation: All images prebuilt before A1. Image switches and validator restart occur only before setup/warmup. No compiler, tests or microbenchmarks overlap any live measurement. Persistent volumes are preserved.
